title.en: Wishes and regrets: wish, if only, would rather
title.es: Deseos y arrepentimientos: wish, if only, would rather

summary.en: Use **wish** or **if only** + **past simple** for a present situation you would like to be different, **past perfect** for a regret about the past, and **would** for annoying habits or changes you want in other people. _I wish I **lived** nearer._ _I wish I **hadn't said** that._ _I wish he **would stop**._ Use **would rather** for preferences.
summary.es: El verbo va un paso atrás en el tiempo: deseo sobre el presente = pasado simple (I wish I had…), sobre el pasado = past perfect (I wish I had been…). Para quejas, wish + would. Cuidado: I wish I would es raro.

form: Present wish: **wish / if only** + past simple (_were_ for all persons in careful English)
Past regret: **wish / if only** + past perfect
Annoyance or wanted change: **wish / if only** + **would** + infinitive
Preference: **would rather** + infinitive; **would rather** + subject + past simple; **would rather have** + past participle

uses.text: **Unreal present**: _I wish I **had** a bigger flat._ _If only she **were** here._
**Regret about the past**: _I wish I **had listened** to my teacher._ _If only we **hadn't sold** the house._
**Complaints and wanted change** (not about yourself): _I wish the neighbours **would turn** the music down._

note.en: Wish + would is for things that someone else controls. We don't say I wish I would.
note.es: Wish + would, sobre otras personas o cosas; no con I.

uses.text: **Preferences**: _I'**d rather** stay in tonight._ _I'**d rather** you **didn't** smoke here._
**Past preference**: _I'**d rather have** gone by train._

mistakes.wrong: I wish I would have more free time.
mistakes.right: I wish I had more free time.

why.en: For your own situation use the past simple, not would.
why.es: Tu propia situación: pasado simple, no would.

mistakes.wrong: I wish I studied harder at school.
mistakes.right: I wish I had studied harder at school.

why.en: A regret about the past needs the past perfect.

mistakes.wrong: I'd rather to stay at home.

why.en: Would rather is followed by the bare infinitive.

mistakes.wrong: I'd rather you don't tell anyone.
mistakes.right: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone.

why.en: When the subject changes, would rather takes the past simple for the present or future.
why.es: Con otro sujeto, would rather + pasado.

examples.en: I wish I could play the piano as well as you do.
If only I lived closer to the sea.
examples.es: Ojalá viviera más cerca del mar.

examples.en: She wishes she hadn't moved to such a noisy street.
I wish I had kept in touch with my old classmates.
examples.es: Ojalá hubiera mantenido el contacto con mis compañeros de clase.

examples.en: If only he hadn't lost his temper in the interview!
I wish the buses would run more often on Sundays.
I'd rather have a quiet weekend than go out again.
Would you rather we met at the station or at the café?
I'd rather you hadn't told her about the surprise.

practice.prompt: I don't have a car. I wish I ___ one.
I failed the exam. If only I ___ more last month!

explanation.en: Regret about the past: past perfect.

practice.prompt: The tap keeps dripping. I wish someone ___ fix it.

explanation.en: A wanted change by another person: wish + would.

practice.prompt: I'd rather ___ in a hotel than camp.

explanation.en: Would rather is followed by the bare infinitive.
